notes.title: Content update DOOMER №1 is available! Changelog post.
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44355443/2152978a1c153df1a05982cbf23fa164c59ddb1d.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=n5YBh0wvxQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings from the Doomer development team! 

We apologize for the long absence of any news and game updates since the announcement of our roadmap. As is often the case, everything that could go wrong went wrong. As we built all the processes and implemented what we promised, it took more time than expected.

Now that the time has come, we are pleased to present you with the first content update, which is quite significant in scope, but represents only a small part of what's planned.

Let's talk about future plans before we get into the details of the update. From now on, we'll release updates more frequently. We can't reveal the content or dates yet, but there won't be such long breaks between updates anymore. In the next step, we'll rework the technical foundation of the game, optimize everything that's "under the hood", and then start developing game mechanics.  

And yes, you read that right, Doomer will feature game mechanics and a clearly defined gameplay cycle. And naturally, we will add more nostalgic items, references, and elements that are signature to the time. 

Sincerely yours, the Doomer team.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

Now for the content update:

[h3]1) Character:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doomer can now run, jump, and crouch; 
[*] When running, the camera wobbles more intensely than when walking; 
[*] Removed camera shake with the option to turn it on if you want to; 
[*] The phone model has been updated to Pokia :), which is more relevant to the time when the game takes place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a188f61e42894362f6dbb6bd19c2a4fc4ea0527a.png[/img]

[*] The phone interface has been updated with the ability to call, but no one will answer...yet.
[*] The ability to take photos through the phone has been removed, since it does not correspond to the time of the game. We will get back to this and explore ideas of how to do photos and screenshots later. However, it won't be done with the phone camera, that is for sure.
[*] A redesigned item interaction system has been added. For example, the rat isn't a part of your pocket anymore. It lives in the cage. You can get it out and put it back in.
[*] Like any doomer character can now die, there are several ways to do that. Feel free to experiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/3e68d2ac9c7474b79bd45d5cb99dbf2d07a1ff5e.png[/img]

[h3]2) Doomers apartment: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You are able to open and close almost all of the doors and windows in the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/5cff5bcf28629d3bccc022a901099b6a09f0aeee.png[/img]

[*] Now, there are switches in all rooms, so lights can be turned on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/b3d54fe0f6aa26a5e0e0a21749cc4e7d1b02a681.png[/img]

[*] A gas stove can be lit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/98dfcd234bd4ae7c34de82ee0425524b897f0adf.png[/img]

[*] Lots and lots of authentic items that are appropriate for the time the events of the game take place. Brand new models of items made from scratch, including Dendy consoles, cartridges, videotapes, books, Great Dragon and Technics of Youth magazines, as well as video and audio tape recorders. There is no sense to list it all, just explore and enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/da0d2dc40de74973c52b9f4b9aafbb0ba00a3db3.png[/img]

[*] It is now possible to pick up and inspect items. At the moment, not all of the items are eligible for that, but we will be gradually adding the ability to inspect them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/d0462bd2891aadd4e39545f58ff27014393bbe9f.png[/img]

[*] You can now watch TV

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/4733d70221e4a1471087a9f3680376decc5c4f2c.png[/img]

[*] The apartment has a telephone now, you should expect a call.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/0d68cd37f25ba3bc4c6c04775a1246941081907a.png[/img]

[*] There has been a change in the apartment's furnishings. Now that Doomer has a new table, he has rearranged some stuff around the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a0829a33c001b6476d352c65d53fc1b5737e4da3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]3) Other: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The apartment building has the entrance now, you can access it from the doomers apartment. It allows you to go out onto the street, or access the roof. We attempted to make the entrance as authentic as possible using relevant objects and attributes of the time, writings on the walls, ashtrays, bottles, etc. You can explore, ring your neighbors doorbells and find ways to entertain yourself, maybe getting an achievement or two while you are at it. We'll add more activities over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/21af654deca04ab7b71da3c2f58b8e0c5866fc48.png[/img]

[*] You can access the roof now. There you can walk around, smoke a cigarette and contemplate about your life while looking at the surrounding landscape from above. That, and all other sorts of activities you can think of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/ed588cf12a3e2d49c65d176816eb067478b96803.png[/img]

[*] The lighting has been updated, smoothly transitioning to dynamic lighting;
[*] A variety of ambient sounds, clocks, birds outside the window, street noise, computer startup, and others have been added;
[*] Picked bottles can be thrown anywhere if you click the left mouse button after picking them up. Give it a try, experiment with it...
[*] The railroad in the area is now fully operational. Watch the departing train doomer and think about life...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/22e9c53431eab3db83538a30e8ebaa4288659f6a.png[/img]

[*] There are many hidden activities now. We won't reveal them, but we are sure you'll enjoy finding them. Don't be afraid to explore the neighborhood and the apartment, something interesting is surely waiting for you there.
[*] Lines 97 is now installed on the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/148831f1c301faefebc99afe8b59060462602009.png[/img]

[*] Several parked cars appeared on the streets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/f6c1c58ff973e05e6ba858dcb99dbe29dbb768d2.png[/img]

[*] The apartment buildings themselves were embellished with authentic external elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/39c98f3492ff6d169f16dc25766b04390af4f81d.png[/img]

[*] Old achievements have been remade to match the spirit of the game and the changes we've made. You'll find new secret achievements as well, look for ways to unlock them and just have fun.  
[/list]

[h3]Enjoy the game!!![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.65 Released!
notes.notes:
Version 1.65 has been released!

NOTE: For the first bug below to be fixed completely, old saved games should no longer be used. This patch is mostly bug fixes.

- FIX: Fixed a bug where the opponent faces weren't always being saved properly at times, so were always the same face after loading a saved game. This could sometimes result in rare '53 Not Found' crashes after a match when loading a saved game.
- FIX: Fixed a visual bug where the 'Repair' button was still visible even after discarding a weapon.
- FIX: Corrected a visual bug where the lower, already purchased upgrade buttons were visible when upgraded to Level 3 or higher.
- FIX: (Probable) Fixed a rare bug where 'Command 1' was visible as a ludus upgrade after the start of a new season and did nothing once clicked but create an empty space.
- FIX: Corrected a rare issue that caused a crash when a warrior retired suddenly due to injury.

notes.title: Version 1.6 Released!
notes.notes:
This is mostly a small bug fix and feature addition patch.

- FEATURE: Added a feature where you can discard an existing weapon and buy a new one for a warrior. They're no longer bonded to the warrior for life.
- FIX: Fixed an issue where when you muted the music in the options menu, it did not mute instantly.
- TWEAK: Tweaked the new CPU warrior generation so that starting stats are about 2-6% higher than before, to account for weapons and make the game slightly tougher.

Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.5 patch released!
notes.notes:
Version 1.5 of Elysium is out!! NOTE: This version is NOT compatible with previous saved games, due to internal data changes.

- NEW FEATURE: Added 18 equippable Weapons for your warriors! Each weapon has a slightly randomized damage range, gold cost and durability. They wear out over time and will need 
to be repaired every so often to avoid breakage.
- NEW FEATURE: Added ambient music to the management screens. A number of pieces of music will rotate randomly. Can be shut off as before on the options screen, if you choose.
- TWEAK: Tweaked free warrior generation to tone down the stats of the generated warriors 3-5%, and adjusted their costs, potential ranges and average age up slightly as well. Now it makes 
a little more sense to develop your own guys, as the free warriors average hidden potential and amount of time they'll be at their peak is reduced overall.
- TWEAK: Further tweaked the CPU warrior development to keep the environment challenging from season to season.
- TWEAK: Adjusted aging a bit to penalize warriors past the age of 55-60 a little more.
- TWEAK: Increased the chance of early retirement slightly due to significant injury or very poor performance.
- TWEAK: Increased the pause at the end of a combat, so if something happens (injury, etc.) you have more time to read it.
- TWEAK: Increased the benefits of Soul Quests 5-10% to give more stats and increased the chance of finding Gold by 10%.
- TWEAK: Refactored and cleaned code a bit for a 3-4% speed improvement.
- FIX: Fixed a cosmetic issue where sometimes a empty warrior slot would show up on the next day match-up screen.
- FIX: Fixed a cosmetic issue where sometimes the betting screen didn't show the Cancel icon properly when returning with an existing bet in place.
- FIX: Corrected a rare 'Type Mismatch' crash if your warrior dies during a fight.
- FIX: Disabled the X in the corner of the game window to prevent accidental window closure and odd behavior if clicked in the fight screen.
- FIX: Fixed an issue where rarely when a CPU warrior retires, their career stats weren't cleared properly for their replacement.
- FIX: Fixed an issue where sometimes if you released a warrior, their career stats weren't cleared properly for their replacement.
- HOTFIX (1/27): Fixed an issue where you couldn't upgrade past the first level of arenas.

Enjoy and please let me know if you have any issues or problems.
Derek

notes.title: New 1.5 patch upcoming on Monday!
notes.notes:
The new 1.5 patch is currently in testing, and adds two new features and lots of tweaks!

- Weapons will be in! Equip your men easily and quickly with 20 different weapons in the Armory, complete with slightly randomized damage ranges, costs and durability wear and tear over time. 

- By popular demand -- new ambient music on the management screens! A number of custom pieces of music I had commissioned will rotate randomly.

- Lots of little combat and aging tweaks to keep things challenging, along with a few bug fixes.

The new patch should be out Monday or so.

notes.title: Version 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 of Elysium has been released, which includes a brand new feature and various tweaks to the engine.

- NEW FEATURE: Added new Ludus Upgrades! You can purchase upgrades to your Ludus using gold, which can increase your warrior's stats, award additional Gold or Influence points, or award extra damage or increase the chance to hit the opponent. You can stack up to 10 different cumulative upgrades during a manager career.
- TWEAK: Adjusted warriors aging arc slightly to give a little more variation to the curves, introducing the possibility of "busts" or warriors blossoming suddenly at a slightly later age than normal.
- TWEAK: Adjusted the CPU warriors career arcs slightly to better keep pace with the league, to keep your warriors from being too dominant within a few seasons with an aggressively training manager.
- TWEAK: Adjusted energy loss a tiny bit so it doesn't drain so fast that a warrior is basically spent by the end of a 10 Day season, even if you rest them a few days.

Enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 of Elysium has been released, focusing mostly on combat tweaking to make the overall fight results somewhat more consistent and "real". More will be done if needed, but through 60 fights or so on my end, it looks good.

- TWEAK: The effects of luck on fight results has been decreased about 10%.
- TWEAK: The effects of a warrior's energy were too exaggerated and was overly influencing fight results. They have been decreased around 5%.
- TWEAK: The effects of Bribes were too small, and have been increased around 3-10%.
- TWEAK: Tweaked the attitude AI to change slightly more with the match flow.
- FIX: Fixed a rare bug that crashed the game with a missing image.
- FIX: Fixed a rare bug that sometimes caused action buttons to appear on the Roster screen on a blank slot.

Enjoy!
Derek
